<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>the Modbus server cannot serve this value: …</span></div>

## Why it happens

The register address or function code does not exist on the PLC. The gateway counts addresses from 0, so register 40001 in a PLC manual is address 0 with function code 3.

## Fix it

Correct the address and function code in the connector's key, following the PLC manual. Subtract the 40001, 30001, 10001 or 00001 offset.

## Check that it worked

The key's value appears on the device.
